methodology: Ranges are built from scope-matched local observations and shown with Price Confidence: INSUFFICIENT under 10 observations, DIRECTIONAL at 10-24, PUBLISHED (median with P25-P75) at 25+, and HIGH only at 50+ with a strong share of written quotes and final invoices and no single provider dominating the sample. We report medians and percentiles, not averages, and we never blend advertised, quoted, and final-invoiced prices. Current ranges are built from Austin operators' published pricing (advertised rates) and are being upgraded with written quotes and final invoices. We show the confidence because we'd rather be honest about uncertainty than pretend to a precision we haven't earned yet.

faqs.q: Is $150–$350 a month reasonable for weekly pool service in Austin?
faqs.a: That's the fair local range across Austin operators' published rates. Basic productized plans start near $99–$189; full weekly service with chemicals typically runs $225–$385 depending on pool size and complexity. Always confirm what's included before comparing quotes.

This range is built from Austin operators' advertised prices — a solid starting signal, but advertised rates aren't the same as what people actually pay. As we add written quotes and final invoices, the range tightens and confidence rises.

faqs.q: Does weekly service include equipment repair?
faqs.a: Almost never. Routine service covers cleaning and water chemistry. Pumps, heaters, and filter repairs are billed separately, usually at an hourly rate plus parts. Ask for that rate up front.

faqs.q: How much does it cost to resurface a pool in Austin?
faqs.a: For a standard pool, expect roughly $7,400–$12,600 depending on finish. Basic plaster sits at the low end; quartz and pebble finishes cost more but last longer. We have only a small sample so far, so treat this as a starting range.

faqs.q: Is a $14,000 resurfacing quote too high?
faqs.a: It can be reasonable for a larger pool or premium pebble finish with tile and coping work — or it can be padded. Compare scope, not just price. Upload the quote and we'll show how it stacks up.

faqs.q: How much does recurring house cleaning cost in Austin?
faqs.a: For a standard 3-bed home on a biweekly plan, the fair local range is about $99–$220 per visit across Austin operators. Some price flat by home size; others charge roughly $90–$95/hr for a team of two. One-time and first-time deep cleans cost more.

faqs.q: Why is recurring cheaper per visit than a one-time clean?
faqs.a: A maintained home takes less time, so recurring visits price lower. A first-time or deep clean is more labor — often 1.5–2x a routine visit.

faqs.q: How much should lawn mowing cost in Austin?
faqs.a: For a standard lot, the fair local range is about $35–$70 per visit for mow, edge, trim, and blow. Booking marketplaces average near $37–$45; local operators vary. Very large or sloped lots cost more.

faqs.q: Is weekly or biweekly mowing cheaper?
faqs.a: Per visit, weekly is often slightly cheaper because the grass is easier to cut; biweekly costs a bit more each visit. Weekly usually costs more per month overall but keeps the lawn healthier in peak season.
